threat-protection.description: Detect threats, require explicit confirmation and gate tool calls.

prompt-redaction.description: Redact recognized secrets and personal data from model-facing prompts (GitHub Copilot only; Cursor hooks cannot rewrite prompt text).

audit-log.description: Record session lifecycle, prompts and policy decisions.

tool-audit.description: Record tool calls, argument previews and outcomes.

license-check.description: Scan newly added dependencies for blocked licenses (GPL/AGPL/etc.) at turn end; warn or block.

note: Optional feature inventory for setup workflows. Codex does not support governance-audit hooks.
